text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
After several days and nights of<n>repeatedly
soaking and simmering<n>multiple varieties of
soybeans, it's<n>finally time for them to become
miso!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My fantastic, newly developed<n>Pearl-brand miso is
going to breathe<n>new life into the world of miso
paste!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The possibilities of miso are endless!<n>Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl becomes so<n>immersed in her
miso paste project<n>that she ends up pulling several
consecutive all-nighters...
